decision.observation: 0 mph, gear 1, timer 24:45.101, one blue dot, no red X. The car has left the gravel and now sits on grass well up-frame and left of the road, with the lake on the left and dark pine trunks directly ahead and to the right; the road curves away at the lower right.
decision.hypothesis: The W+A beat at 11 mph carried the car past the outside of the right-hand bend and off the road into the grass, stalling it at 0 mph. From a standstill plain W first replays the proven restart, but if speed stays at 0 it is a forward pin against the trunks and needs a reverse.
decision.memory: A=screen-right held up again: at 11 mph it overshot the right bend and put the car on the left-side grass, so short 0.5 s steer beats rather than full seconds are needed near bends at ~11 mph.
